selection: Institutes without institute_classification at merge time

records.name: Birla Institute of Technology & Science - Pilani
records.statutory_basis: Institution deemed to be a university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956; notification dated 18 June 1964
records.evidence: BITS Pilani's official UGC Approval page identifies it as an Institution Deemed to be University established under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. Its official Pilani campus page confirms the Pilani campus and residential student programmes.
notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical BITS family is added.

records.name: VIT
records.statutory_basis: Institution deemed to be a university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
records.evidence: VIT's official About VIT page states that it was established under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. Its official recognition material describes VIT as a deemed-to-be university and a private institution.
notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical VIT family is added.

records.name: CDAC
records.statutory_basis: Autonomous scientific society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India; offers C-DAC postgraduate diploma training
records.evidence: C-DAC's official About page identifies it as an autonomous R&D organisation under MeitY. The institute's official education/admissions material documents postgraduate diploma programmes, so it belongs in the skill/diploma group and admits students.
notes: Classified as G9 because this record represents C-DAC's student-facing postgraduate diploma/training route, not a degree university. Family row is not present.

records.name: LBSNAA Mussoorie (Training Academy)
records.statutory_basis: Attached office of the Department of Personnel & Training, Government of India; post-selection civil-services training academy
records.evidence: The official LBSNAA page says the academy is an attached office of DoPT and conducts foundation, professional and in-service training for civil-service entrants and officers. Entry follows UPSC/service selection; it is not an open admissions college.
notes: X is intentional: this is a post-selection employer/service academy, not a student-admitting higher-education institute.

records.name: Drishti IAS
records.evidence: The supplied official Drishti IAS domain identifies the organisation as a private civil-services preparation provider offering UPSC/PCS classroom and online courses. This is coaching/training, not a UGC university or college.
notes: G10b is Phase 2 coaching; keep listed status controlled by the loader. No statutory higher-education regulator applies.

records.name: Vision IAS
records.evidence: The supplied official Vision IAS domain identifies the organisation as a private UPSC civil-services preparation provider with courses, test series and mentorship. This is coaching/training, not a UGC university or college.
notes: G10b is Phase 2 coaching; no statutory higher-education regulator applies.

records.name: Vajiram & Ravi
records.evidence: The supplied official Vajiram & Ravi domain identifies the organisation as a private civil-services examination coaching provider offering UPSC preparation courses. It is not a UGC university or college.
notes: G10b is Phase 2 coaching; no statutory higher-education regulator applies.

records.name: Navkar Institute
records.evidence: The supplied official Navkar Institute domain identifies a private coaching provider for CA, CS and CMA examinations. Professional exam preparation is a training route, not a UGC degree institution.
notes: G10b is Phase 2 coaching. ICAI/ICSI/ICMAI own the professional routes; Navkar is not the statutory route owner.

records.name: VG Learning Destination
records.evidence: The supplied official VG Learning Destination domain identifies a private coaching provider for CA and professional accounting examinations. Professional exam preparation is training, not a UGC degree institution.
notes: G10b is Phase 2 coaching. ICAI owns the CA route; VG Learning Destination is not the statutory route owner.

records.name: CMC Vellore
records.statutory_basis: Unaided minority educational institution; medical programmes subject to NMC recognition and university affiliation
regulators: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University
records.evidence: CMC Vellore's official About Us page explicitly describes it as an unaided minority educational institution in Vellore and confirms medical, nursing and allied-health education. It is therefore a private medical college/college-level provider, not a private university.
notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical CMC family is added.

records.name: Bombay Flying Club
records.statutory_basis: society
records.evidence: The DGCA approved-FTO list includes The Bombay Flying Club, and the Government of India records it as a functional CPL flying-training organisation. It is a training provider rather than a university.
notes: Mapped to the existing dgca_fto family; this family is currently grouped under G8 in the database taxonomy.

records.name: Pearl Academy
records.statutory_basis: private_society
records.evidence: Pearl Academy describes itself as a private design institution whose current bachelor's and master's degrees are offered through its CAES-RGNIYD arrangement; the academy itself is a private design school, not a separate university.
notes: Degrees under the RGNIYD arrangement should not be used to classify Pearl Academy as G3; parent/awarding-body linkage is a separate cleanup concern.

records.name: Symbiosis Institute of Design Pune
records.statutory_basis: ugc_deemed
records.evidence: SID's official site identifies it as a constituent of Symbiosis International (Deemed University), and its mandatory disclosure cites Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
notes: Constituent-institute parent link to Symbiosis International should be added by the department/parent cleanup pass.

records.name: SP Jain Mumbai
records.statutory_basis: trust
records.evidence: SPJIMR's official AICTE disclosure lists its approved PGDM programmes and Category-I graded autonomy; it is a standalone management institute rather than a UGC university.

records.name: NCTE Recognised B.Ed Colleges
records.evidence: NCTE's official recognised-institutions service lists B.Ed institutions across multiple management types and affiliating universities.
notes: This is a mixed catalogue/category row, not one identifiable college; it cannot receive one institution_group without splitting it into actual institutions.

records.name: Coursera / edX MicroMasters
records.statutory_basis: company
records.evidence: Coursera and edX provide online courses and professional/MicroMasters credentials from partner institutions; edX states that a MicroMasters credential is not itself a university admission or degree. This is an online learning-platform category, not a university.
notes: Keep awarding universities as separate providers; the platform row should not be treated as a degree-granting institution.

records.name: XLRI
records.statutory_basis: society
records.evidence: XLRI's official release identifies its AICTE-approved PGDM programmes and describes XLRI as a business school founded by the Society of Jesus; it is not a UGC university.

records.name: Chennai Mathematical Institute
records.statutory_basis: ugc_deemed
records.evidence: CMI's official 2026 brochure states that it was recognised as a university under Section 3 of the UGC Act in 2006 and directly awards B.S., M.Sc. and Ph.D. degrees.

records.name: Amity University (Actuarial Science)
records.statutory_basis: state_act
records.evidence: Amity's official course page identifies the Noida B.Sc. Actuarial Science programme as a programme of Amity University Uttar Pradesh; the record is a programme-specific legacy row whose parent is the UGC-listed state private university.
notes: Parent-institute linking should point this programme row to Amity University Uttar Pradesh.

records.name: Bishop Heber College
records.statutory_basis: autonomous_affiliated_college
records.evidence: Bishop Heber's official institutional profile identifies it as an autonomous institution affiliated to Bharathidasan University, with aided and self-financed programmes; its official site records UGC/AICTE approval and NAAC accreditation.
notes: The college has both aided and self-financed streams; govt_aided reflects its aided/autonomous institutional classification, not state ownership.

records.name: Presidency University Kolkata
records.statutory_basis: Presidency University Act, 2010 (West Bengal)
records.evidence: The university's official institutional information describes Presidency University Kolkata as a university established by the Government of West Bengal under the Presidency University Act, 2010, and its official site publishes undergraduate and postgraduate admissions.
notes: State public university; no matching canonical family row was found in the families table.

records.name: Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC)
records.statutory_basis: Constituent college of the University of Delhi (Central University)
records.evidence: SRCC's official website states that Shri Ram College of Commerce is a constituent college of the University of Delhi; its official prospectus and departments pages list undergraduate and postgraduate courses and admissions.
notes: Constituent-college row, not a separate university.

records.name: Loyola College
records.statutory_basis: UGC autonomous college affiliated to the University of Madras; grant-in-aid and self-financing institution
records.evidence: Loyola's official profile identifies it as Loyola College (Autonomous), affiliated to the University of Madras, with grant-in-aid and self-financing categories, UGC recognition and undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes.
notes: Autonomous affiliated college; degrees are conferred by the University of Madras.

records.name: St. Xaviers College
records.statutory_basis: Empowered autonomous constituent college affiliated to the University of Mumbai under the Maharashtra State Public Universities Act, 2016
records.evidence: The official handbook states that St. Xavier's College is an empowered autonomous college affiliated with the University of Mumbai and conducts government-aided and self-financing degree courses; the official admissions site lists current UG and PG admissions.
notes: Name retained exactly as supplied; official branding uses St. Xavier's College.

records.name: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics
records.statutory_basis: Empowered autonomous college affiliated to the University of Mumbai
records.evidence: The college's official website identifies Narsee Monjee College of Commerce & Economics as an empowered autonomous college affiliated to the University of Mumbai and provides undergraduate admission requirements.
notes: Managed by Shri Vile Parle Kelavani Mandal; funding classification was not stated on the official page, so ownership is recorded as trust.

records.name: Christ University
records.statutory_basis: Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 (Gazette notification, 22 July 2008)
records.evidence: CHRIST's official disclosures identify it as CHRIST (Deemed to be University), recognised by the Ministry of Education under Section 3 of the UGC Act, with Christ Educational Society as sponsoring body; the university publishes undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.
notes: Private deemed university; the canonical family row is private_deemed.

records.name: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce
records.statutory_basis: UGC autonomous grant-in-aid college affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University
records.evidence: The official college page states that Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce is autonomous under UGC, continues under Savitribai Phule Pune University for degree conferral, and offers undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes; its official prospectus identifies it as grant-in-aid.
notes: This is the autonomous affiliated college, not Symbiosis International (a separate deemed university).

records.name: Lady Shri Ram College for Women
records.statutory_basis: Constituent college of the University of Delhi (Central University)
records.evidence: LSR's official NAAC self-study report identifies Lady Shri Ram College as a constituent college of the University of Delhi; the official college site describes its student-facing undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.
notes: Constituent-college row under the central University of Delhi.

records.name: St. Josephs College of Commerce

records.evidence: The official institution page states that St Joseph's College of Commerce is managed by the Bangalore Jesuit Educational Society and received autonomous status from UGC; official admission materials identify current BCom and other programmes affiliated to Bengaluru City University.
notes: Name retained exactly as supplied; official branding uses St. Joseph's College of Commerce.

records.evidence: Hans Raj College's official page states that it is a constituent college of the University of Delhi and imparts education at undergraduate and graduate levels to students.
notes: Existing legacy-type research also confirmed the constituent-college status from this official page.

records.statutory_basis: Autonomous institution of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India

records.name: Institute of Financial Management and Research (IFMR)

Krea is a private university, so this current IFMR record belongs to the private-university constituent group.
notes: The legacy name predates the Krea integration; keep the institute record but add a parent-institute relationship to Krea University when available.

notes: The India Chapter is a local society/community record under the global CFA Institute; ownership is not applicable for G10a.

notes: Family row is not present in the current families table; leave family_slug null until the canonical MAHE/Srishti family mapping is added.
